capabilities: Restyle the sidebar and panels with a Typora-like frosted-glass look
Merge the Outline panel and Properties metadata into one sidebar view
Designate a home note that opens on startup and when all tabs are closed
Enable single-page mode with an LRU tab cache and cross-tab back/forward history
Apply custom typography such as JetBrains Mono and Forest-style blockquotes, tables and code blocks
disambiguation: Not just a CSS theme; it also changes navigation behavior with single-page mode, an LRU tab cache, and a home note that opens at startup.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and is installed manually from GitHub Releases. The README warns the philosophy runs against mainstream usage: it strips away core features including Folders, so almost every note lives in the vault root, and recommends timestamp-prefixed filenames to avoid name clashes. The Page Load Animation feature is marked Beta.
problem: Obsidian's default interface shows many panels, tabs, action buttons and sidebars that add visual noise and distract from writing.

relations.evidence: Transform Obsidian into a minimal, Typora-style writing environment.

summary: Typora-style interface plugin that minimizes the Obsidian UI, restructures the sidebar, and adds single-page navigation with a home note.
